meaning: Retain an exact original generated Workflow ESM experiment and require source, compiled artifacts, native observations, all three audit facets and all compiler/runtime/declaration dependencies to remain current.

construction.product: Verified retained Workflow execution without changing Workflow behavior
construction.business: Consumers can reject stale or incomplete compiler evidence instead of treating a prior pass as current
construction.domainspec: Existing checked project plan, registered full Workflow controls and registered source-derived three-facet audit
construction.compiled_system: Original strict ES2022 NodeNext output in an exclusive retained module workspace
construction.implementation: Separate private ESM executor; existing CommonJS executor and generators unchanged

custody: Snapshot Node executable, full TypeScript/platform trees and resolved Node declaration dependency trees before workspace creation. Copy exact captured generated sources and declarations into an exclusive private workspace, reject symbolic/unsafe paths and unexpected files, check retained artifacts and tool/dependency fingerprints before and after each subprocess and whenever a registered receipt is used.
audits: Require exact complete module observations, source hashes and no violations for module surface, effects and orchestration on both source and native bytes. Never replace independent facets with a merged empty-violations check.
batching: Process every ready Workflow row with its complete 1-4 batch sequence in one original ESM module instance per row. Retain every batch input and output plus exact ordered manifest. Validate every output envelope and aggregate all rows against the registered complete controls; no prefix passes.
failure: Fail closed with exact phase and retained workspace when present. No fallback to CommonJS, weaker audits, partial batches or synthetic model. No ready rows fail before workspace creation. Unavailable rows remain explicit in successful ready-row coverage.
claim_ceiling: Private finite retained interoperability evidence, not public integration, whole-project pass, arbitrary-code security sandbox, admission, activation, release or full CLI completion.
